title: The quantum lifetime of a future-referential feedback loop: certified index, architecture floor, and thermal bonus
summary: A quantum feedback loop that returns information from a forward simulation to an earlier internal time induces a completely positive trace-preserving map on a message register; iterating that map eventually destroys its ability to carry entanglement. The entanglement-breaking index N = n_EB(Phi), the round at which this happens, is studied along two axes, interaction and bath.
